title: Special Executive Programme In Public Health Administration
description: This programme focuses on the structure, management, and regulatory aspects of public health administration.
longDescription: The Special Executive Programme in Public Health Administration equips professionals with knowledge of public health functions, organizational structures, ethics, policies, and financing. It emphasizes management strategies, performance enhancement, and the role of government in health systems.

Participants will explore public health definitions, determinants, and agencies that shape health systems. The program covers the organization and management of public health, with an emphasis on federal services and reforms. It delves into public health regulations, ethics, and financing, as well as promotion strategies and social marketing campaigns. Students will also study performance management techniques and organizational productivity optimization.
